# Cure Global — API design

*v0.1 · 22 Oct 2026 · Conventions and the endpoint map. OpenAPI 3.1 is generated by the `api` service at `/api/v1/openapi.json` (dev and staging only); a typed client is generated into `packages/api-client`.*

## 1. Conventions

| Topic | Rule |
|---|---|
| Base path | `/api/v1` (REST), `/api/v1/hub/*` (hub contract, ADR-0007), `/fhir/r4` (R3), `/internal/*` (webhooks, not public) |
| Format | JSON, `snake_case` fields, UTF-8 |
| Ids | UUIDv7 strings; clients may create ids for offline writes |
| Time | RFC 3339 with `Z` or offset; `date` fields as `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| Units | Canonical UCUM in storage and API (`unit` always present); display conversion is the client's job |
| Success envelope | Resource or `{ "items": [...], "next_cursor": "..." }` for lists. No other envelopes |
| Errors | RFC 9457 Problem Details: `{ type, title, status, detail, instance, errors? }`, with stable `type` URIs (`https://cure.global/problems/consent-required`) |
| Pagination | Cursor (`?cursor=&limit=`), max 200 |
| Filtering | Explicit query params; time ranges `from` / `to` |
| Idempotency | Batch writes carry client ids (`client_reading_id`, `client_entry_id`); other POSTs accept `Idempotency-Key` |
| Concurrency | `ETag` / `If-Match` on mutable resources (person, family, targets, module states) |
| Auth | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (EdDSA). Purpose header `X-Access-Purpose` optional for clinicians (defaults to `treatment`) |
| Acting for someone | Path carries the subject (`/persons/{person_id}/…`); the policy decides (`ACCESS_CONTROL.md` §7) |
| Rate limits | Valkey-backed; per user, per device, per IP for anonymous routes; `429` with `Retry-After` |
| Versioning | Additive changes in v1; breaking changes → v2 with a deprecation window |
| Live updates | Server-Sent Events for the doctor worklist and family app (`/api/v1/events`), authorised per stream |

## 3. Batch write semantics

`POST /persons/{id}/observations:batch` (and the hub equivalent) accepts ≤ 50 items and returns one result per item:

```json
{ "results": [
  { "client_reading_id": "0192…", "status": "created", "id": "0192…" },
  { "client_reading_id": "0193…", "status": "duplicate", "id": "0191…" },
  { "client_reading_id": "0194…", "status": "rejected", "reason": "implausible", "detail": "Diastolic must be lower than systolic." },
  { "client_reading_id": "0195…", "status": "rejected", "reason": "module_inactive" }
]}
```

Rejection reasons are stable codes: `implausible`, `unknown_metric`, `module_inactive`, `not_permitted`, `time_out_of_range` (> 5 min in the future or > 366 days old), `unit_not_allowed`, `consent_required`.

## 4. Events (internal, worker)

| Event | Emitted when | Consumers |
|---|---|---|
| `observation.created` | Any new observation | alert evaluation, summaries, live doctor view |
| `tracker.created` | Any tracker entry | alert evaluation (e.g. seizure > 5 min), summaries |
| `module.changed` | Resolver or user changes a module state | reminders, hub member refresh |
| `consent.withdrawn` | Withdrawal | grants revoked, hub refresh, notifications |
| `alert.opened` / `alert.escalated` | Rule fired / no ack | notification fan-out |
| `person.birthday_threshold` | Nightly | transition flows |
| `location.event` | Traccar webhook | safety alerts |

Events are rows in an `outbox` table written in the same transaction as the change, then dispatched to arq jobs (transactional outbox pattern), so no event is lost if a worker is down.

## 5. As built — Phase 1 core platform (wave 1, 23 Oct 2026)

`packages/api-client/openapi.json` is the contract; this section lists what the map above doesn't show or names differently.

**Access declaration.** Every operation carries `x-access` in the OpenAPI document: `public` · `authenticated` · `self` ·
`policy` (the route calls `authorize()` per subject) · `family:<roles>` · `staff:<roles>` · `practitioner` · `dev`.
`services/api/tests/test_routes.py` fails when a route has none (E4-04).

**Headers.** `Authorization: Bearer <access JWT>` (EdDSA, 15 min, claims `sub` = account, `sid` = session, `mfa`, `amr`) ·
`X-Act-As: user|practitioner|support` for accounts with several roles (default: practitioner, then staff, then family user) ·
`If-Match` / `ETag` (weak) on `/families/{id}`, `/persons/{id}`, person modules · `If-None-Match` on `/catalogue` (ETag = checksum)
· dev/test only: `X-Dev-Actor: super_admin | support:<user_id> | practitioner:<id> | person:<id> | hub:<family_id>`.

**Identity.** `POST /auth/otp/request {phone|email, purpose}` → `{challenge_id}` (6 digits, 10 min, 5 attempts) ·
`POST /auth/otp/verify` → `{otp_token}` · `POST /auth/register {otp_token, password, given_name, date_of_birth, …, accept_terms}`
(phone → account + own person + platform_terms/health_data consents + tokens; email → account with mandatory MFA →
`{mfa_enrolment_required, mfa_token}`) · `POST /auth/login` → tokens, or `{mfa_required|mfa_enrolment_required, mfa_token}` ·
`POST /auth/mfa/verify {mfa_token, code|recovery_code}` · `POST /auth/mfa/enroll` + `/auth/mfa/enroll/confirm` (returns 10
recovery codes) · `POST /auth/refresh` (rotation; reuse → 401 `refresh-reuse` and the session ends) · `POST /auth/logout` ·
`GET /auth/jwks` · `POST /auth/password/reset/request` (always 202) + `/confirm {challenge_id, code, new_password}` (ends every
session) · `GET /me` · `POST /me/password` · `GET /me/sessions` · `DELETE /me/sessions/{id}` · `GET/POST/DELETE /me/mfa/totp`,
`POST /me/mfa/totp/confirm`, `POST /me/mfa/recovery-codes` · dev only (404 elsewhere): `GET /auth/dev/accounts`,
`POST /auth/dev/login {email|phone}` · `GET /health` reports `env`. Passkeys (WebAuthn) are not built yet.

**Rate limits** (429 + `Retry-After`; Valkey, in-process fallback): OTP 3 per identifier per 10 min and 20 per IP per hour;
OTP verify 30 per IP per 10 min; login 10 per identifier and 50 per IP per 5 min; refresh 120 per IP per 5 min. Ten failed
passwords lock the account for 15 min (doubling, ≤ 24 h); support can unlock.

**Key rotation.** JWT: put the new Ed25519 key in `JWT_PRIVATE_KEY`, the old public key in `JWT_PREVIOUS_PUBLIC_KEYS`
(both are in the JWKS), remove the old one after 15 minutes. Envelope encryption: new `DEV_KEK`, old one in
`DEV_KEK_PREVIOUS`, run `services/api/scripts/rotate_kek.py` (add `--rehash` unless `LOOKUP_HASH_KEY` is set).

**Families and people.** `GET /families` (staff: all; family users: their own, with `my_role`) · `POST /families` ·
`GET/PATCH /families/{id}` · `GET /families/{id}/members` (identity + hub profile: `display_name`, `avatar_color`,
`language`, `hub_enabled`, `sort_order`, `hub_vital_kinds`; family users also get `can_see` per member) ·
`POST /families/{id}/dependants` (parent | legal_guardian | health_proxy; an evidence id is required for the last two, which
wait for support's review) · `GET/POST /families/{id}/invites` · `POST /invites/{id}/resend` · `DELETE /invites/{id}` ·
`GET /me/invites` · `POST /invites/{id}/accept {sharing: {preset, categories, include_sensitive}}` (Everything
pre-selected) · `POST /invites/{id}/decline` · `PATCH/DELETE /families/{id}/members/{person_id}` ·
`POST /families/{id}/transfer-ownership` + `/accept` + `/cancel` · `GET /me/persons` (`relation`, `families`,
`rights.read/write`) · `GET/PATCH /persons/{id}` · `POST/GET /persons/{id}/photo` (raw image body, metadata stripped) ·
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/guardianships` · `DELETE /guardianships/{id}` · `POST /persons/{id}/deceased` ·
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/contacts` · `PATCH/DELETE /contacts/{id}` · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/identifiers` (NIC, PHN, passport;
encrypted) · `GET /persons/{id}/tasks` · `POST /tasks/{id}/complete` · `POST /persons/{id}/dsar` · `GET /notifications`.

**Consent and sharing.** `GET /consent-policies` · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/consents` · `POST /consents/{id}/withdraw` ·
`POST /consents/{id}/cosign` (joint-guardian rule) · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/grants` · `DELETE /grants/{id}` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/family-sharing` · `PUT /persons/{id}/family-sharing/{family_id} {preset, categories, include_sensitive}`.

**Care.** `GET /practitioners?query=&specialty=` · `POST /practitioners/apply` · `GET /practitioners/me` ·
`GET /practitioners/{id}/panel` · `GET/POST /care-requests` (`family_to_doctor`, or `doctor_to_family` → one-time `code`, 72 h)
· `POST /care-requests/claim {code, family_id, person_id?}` · `POST /care-requests/{id}/accept|decline` ·
`GET /families/{id}/care-teams` · `GET /persons/{id}/care-teams` · `PATCH/DELETE /care-team-members/{id}` ·
`POST /persons/{id}/care-team-consent?care_team_member_id=`.

**Modules.** `GET /catalogue?since=` (unchanged → `{changed: false}`; otherwise modules, metrics, trackers; `release`) ·
`GET /persons/{id}/modules` (only modules the caller may see; each has an `etag`) ·
`PATCH /persons/{id}/modules/{code} {action: accept|decline|pause|resume|activate|end|add|settings, settings}` ·
`GET/PUT /persons/{id}/flags` · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/programmes` · `DELETE /programmes/{id}`.

**Admin.** `GET /admin/families?query=&cursor=&limit=` (family name, member name, or a phone/email matched by keyed hash) ·
`GET /admin/families/{id}` · `POST /admin/families/{id}/support-actions {action: resend_invite|revoke_invite|unlock_account|
end_sessions, target_id, reason}` · `GET /admin/guardianships?status=` · `POST /admin/guardianships/{id}/review` ·
`POST /admin/persons/{id}/deceased` · `GET /admin/practitioners?status=` · `GET /admin/practitioners/{id}` ·
`POST /admin/practitioners/{id}/verify|reject|suspend|reinstate {checklist, notes}` · `GET/POST /admin/organizations` ·
`GET /admin/audit?subject=&actor=&action=&resource_type=&from=&to=&cursor=` · `GET /admin/audit/chain` ·
`POST /admin/audit/chain/verify` · `GET /admin/dsar?status=` · `PATCH /admin/dsar/{id}` · `GET/POST /admin/staff-roles` ·
`DELETE /admin/staff-roles/{id}` · `GET /admin/feature-flags` · `PUT /admin/feature-flags/{key}` ·
`DELETE /admin/feature-flags/{id}` · `GET/POST /admin/catalogue/releases` · `POST /admin/catalogue/releases/{id}/approve`
(clinical_safety_officer) · `/activate` · `GET/POST /admin/consent-policies` · `PATCH /admin/consent-policies/{id}` ·
`GET /admin/consent-policies/reconsent` · `GET /admin/analytics/overview?days=` (k ≥ 5) · break-glass:
`POST /admin/break-glass {subject_person_id, reason ≥ 20 chars, duration_minutes ≤ 60, emergency}` ·
`POST /admin/break-glass/{id}/approve|reject|end|review` · `GET /admin/break-glass` · `GET /admin/break-glass/active`.

**Outbox topics emitted so far:** `module.changed` · `consent.given` · `consent.withdrawn` · `grant.changed` ·
`hub.member_refresh` · `family.member_added` · `family.member_removed` · `family.owner_changed` · `guardianship.changed` ·
`person.deceased` · `person.birthday_threshold` · `person.duplicate_candidate` · `practitioner.status_changed` ·
`care_team.changed` · `break_glass.opened`. **Notification templates** (`notification.template_code`; params are ids):
`family.invite`, `family.invite_accepted`, `family.ownership_offered`, `consent.given_by_coguardian`, `consent.withdrawn`,
`consent.assisted`, `guardianship.added`, `guardianship.ended`, `guardianship.ended_majority`, `teen.confidentiality_started`,
`care_request.received`, `care_team.consent_requested`, `break_glass.opened`, `break_glass.opened_family`,
`break_glass.dpo_review`, `break_glass.approval_needed`.

## 6. As built — records, medicines, scheduling, safety, summaries (wave 2, 23 Oct 2026)

Every route below builds one `AccessContext` and decides **per record under the record's own module** (`module_code`):
a reading in `pregnancy.bp` is checked with that module's teen-confidential and reproductive-health flags, so it simply
isn't in a guardian's or family admin's list, chart, count or calendar (no trace). Responses have Pydantic models, so
`packages/api-client` carries real types. Times are UTC `…Z`; local dates and times are in the family's zone.

**Observations.** `POST /persons/{id}/observations:batch {items ≤ 50}` — item: `client_reading_id`, `metric` (catalogue
code; hub kinds accepted: `sugar` → `glucose`), `value`, `value2` (BP diastolic), `unit` (an allowed UCUM unit or
`mmHg`/`bpm`/`°C`/`°F`/`lb`/`in`; stored canonical), `context`, `effective_at`, `module_code` (default: the core module that
records the metric), `source`, `method`, `identified_by`, `device_validated`, `is_extra`, `raw`. Result per item:
`created | duplicate | rejected`, reasons as §3 plus `invalid` (bad context, source or time order) and, for trackers,
`unknown_tracker`. A device actor's items are always `source=hub`. `consent_required` when the person's `health_data`
consent isn't in force. Same person + metric + value from a **different** source within 2 min → stored with
`duplicate_of_id` (E7-06) and left out of charts and summaries. Implausible values get a unit hint
("Did you mean [degF]?", HZ-14); urgent-band values are stored as measured (HZ-18).
`GET /persons/{id}/observations?metric=&from=&to=&include_entered_in_error=&cursor=&limit=` (keyset on effective_at, id) ·
`GET /observations/{id}` (+ `revisions`) · `PATCH /observations/{id} {action: amend|entered_in_error, reason, value?,
value2?, unit?, context?}` (E7-05; the person, a guardian or the care team; history in `revisions`).

**Chart series (brief §5.3).** `GET /persons/{id}/series/{metric}?days=1..366&context=` → `{person_id, metric, unit,
display_unit, days, context, aggregated, points[{id, t, v, v2, source, context, estimated, validated, module_code}],
daily[{date, n, mean, min, max, mean2}], averages{7d, 30d, 90d: {v, v2, n}}, latest{…point, status, target_id, safety_net,
identified_by}, target{id, metric, kind, module_code, context, low, high, low2, high2, attention_low, attention_high,
attention_low2, attention_high2, note, set_by, set_at}, targets[], time_zone, modules[]}`. More than 200 readings →
`aggregated: true`, `points: []`. `status` ∈ within | above | below | attention | check | none, from the person's own
target only (context-specific first, then the reading's module, then an overlay's target over the core one); `check` only
for implausible values; estimated-tier readings (cuffless, wearable APIs) are `none` (HZ-08). `safety_net` is the
`safety.urgent_reading.<metric>` text id for urgent-band values (CLINICAL_SAFETY.md §4.1). `modules` = what the caller
may see. Daily rows come from `observation_daily_summary`.

**Trackers.** `POST /persons/{id}/trackers:batch` (item: `client_entry_id`, `tracker`, `started_at`, `ended_at?`, `data`,
`module_code?`, `source`) — `data` is validated against the catalogue's JSON Schema; rejections carry
`errors[{field, msg}]`; `checkin` entries are refused (use the check-in endpoint). `GET /persons/{id}/trackers?code=&from=&to=&cursor=`
· `GET /persons/{id}/trackers/summary?code=&days=` → `daily[{date, n, values}]` + `totals` (feeds: `volume_ml`,
`duration_min`, `kind_*`; nappies: `wet`, `dirty`; sleep diary: `sleep_hours`, `wakings`, `naps_min`; seizures:
`seizure_minutes`, `longest_seconds`; behaviour: `mean_intensity`; any timed entry: `duration_min`).

**Targets (E17-03).** `GET /persons/{id}/targets?metric=&history=` (+ `ETag`) · `PUT /persons/{id}/targets {items[{metric,
context?, module_code?, low, high, low2, high2, attention_*, note, clear?}]}` with optional `If-Match`. Practitioners only;
each item needs write on its module's category (Dr Fernando sets `pregnancy.bp`; the family doctor can't). Each item
replaces the current target for (metric, module, context) or retires it (`clear`); others are untouched; history is kept.
Validation (HMS H-07): low < high, attention levels outside the band, values in the plausible range, secondary bounds for
BP only, catalogue contexts. `app/records/targets.py hub_target()` gives the hub contract's `vital_target` row.

**Reviews (E17-04).** `POST /persons/{id}/reviews {metrics, period_start, period_end, message?, module_code}` (care-team
clinician; the message is encrypted at rest) · `GET /persons/{id}/reviews?latest=&limit=` → `{items, latest}` with
`reviewer_name`. The person and their guardians get `care.readings_reviewed` (ids only; not for teen-confidential reviews).

**Documents (E7-04).** `POST /persons/{id}/documents?title=&category=&document_date=&module_code=&share_with_care_team=`
with the raw file as the body (PDF/JPEG/PNG/WebP by content, ≤ 10 MB; images lose EXIF/XMP/text chunks; virus scan
before storage — `VIRUS_SCANNER` eicar (dev) | clamd (staging/production default, fails closed) | none) ·
`GET /persons/{id}/documents` · `GET /documents/{id}` · `GET /documents/{id}/content` → `{url, expires_at, mime, size,
filename}` (5-minute link, audited as `export`; an S3 presigned URL when `S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT` is set, otherwise the API's
own signed `GET /documents/{id}/download?exp=&sig=`). Never on the hub. **Conditions and allergies:**
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/conditions` (a catalogue `tag` re-runs the resolver) · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/allergies`.

**Medicines.** `GET /persons/{id}/medications?include_inactive=` · `POST /persons/{id}/medications {name, dose_text,
instructions, strength, form, start_on, end_on, times_of_day[HH:MM], days_of_week?, module_code}` · `PATCH /medications/{id}`
· `PUT /medications/{id}/schedule {times_of_day, days_of_week?}` (from today; past days keep their schedule). Outputs also
carry the hub contract's fields (`dosage`, `frequency`, `prescribed_by`, `times_of_day`, `start_date`, `end_date`).
`GET /persons/{id}/doses?date=` → slots with `state` taken | skipped | missed | due | upcoming ·
`PUT /persons/{id}/doses {items[{medication_id, date, slot, status: taken|skipped|missed|pending, client_id}]}` — an
idempotent set (pending clears), per item `set | rejected(not_permitted|unknown_slot|time_out_of_range|invalid)` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/adherence?days=` → `daily[{date, expected, taken, skipped, missed, pct}]`, `overall`, `by_medication`.

**Appointments, calendar, reminders.** `GET /persons/{id}/appointments?from=&to=&include_past=` ·
`POST /persons/{id}/appointments {type, starts_at | date + time (local), practitioner_id?, doctor_name, specialty,
branch_name, status, queue_number, session_start (local HH:MM), module_code}` · `PATCH /appointments/{id}`. Outputs carry
`local_date`, `local_time`, `session_start`, the hub aliases (`specialization`, `appointment_date`, `appointment_time`)
and, for today's visit, `queue{token, now_serving, patients_ahead, estimated_wait_minutes, state NEXT|UPCOMING}` (10 min a
patient from the session start). `GET /families/{id}/calendar?from=&to=` (members only: calendar entries plus each
member's visible appointments) · `POST /families/{id}/calendar` · `GET /reminders?person_id=|family_id=` ·
`POST /reminders {person_id | family_id, kind, title, rrule (RFC 5545, no SECONDLY/MINUTELY), starts_at, channels}` →
`next_at` evaluated in the reminder's zone.

**Check-ins and SOS (E11-01).** `GET /persons/{id}/checkins?days=` → `{enabled, settings{due_time, grace_minutes},
today{state: done|due|missed|upcoming|not_enabled}, items, completion_pct}` · `POST /persons/{id}/checkins {method:
hub_tap|hub_voice|app|watch, identified_by?, feeling?, client_id}` — an explicit "I'm OK" only (HZ-09: no presence
method exists; hub_tap/hub_voice only from the hub, app/watch only from people); one per local day ·
`PUT /persons/{id}/checkins/settings {due_time, grace_minutes}` (stored in the module's settings) ·
`POST /persons/{id}/sos {client_id, source}` → an `sos_event` and `safety.sos_raised` push notifications to every
owner/admin of the person's families and to their guardians (ids only); a retried `client_id` doesn't alarm twice; anyone
who may see who the person is in the family may raise it · `GET /persons/{id}/sos?open_only=` (location & safety readers
and owners/admins).

**Summary and dashboard.** `GET /persons/{id}/summary` → `{person, view: full|counts|identity, life_stage, sub_stage,
overlays, modules, categories, metrics[{metric, kind, unit, display_unit, latest, freshness, sparkline[14 × {date, mean,
mean2}], target}], due_today{date, done, due, items}, next_appointment, last_review, alerts}`.
`GET /families/{id}/dashboard` (family members only) → `{family, members[{person, view, categories, metrics, due_today,
last_review, next_appointment, alerts}]}`: `full` where the caller may read a category; `counts` (done/due only, no items)
for owners/admins and guardians of someone who shares nothing; `identity` for other members. Counts never include
teen-confidential modules, and include other sensitive modules only when readable. Open SOS alerts show to owners/admins.

**Admin analytics** (decision §2; k ≥ 5, no identities; sensitive and teen-confidential modules excluded):
`GET /admin/analytics/readings?days=` (per-day volumes overall, by source and by metric; totals; active measuring persons
7d/30d; `hub_vs_app_pct`) · `GET /admin/analytics/metrics/{metric}?days=` (histogram of person-day means, daily median and
IQR plus the diastolic median, by life stage) · `GET /admin/analytics/adherence?days=` (medicine adherence and check-in
completion per day). Buckets under 5 distinct persons are `suppressed` with null numbers.

**Outbox topics added:** `observation.created`, `observation.amended`, `tracker.created`, `target.changed`,
`review.created`, `document.created`, `condition.changed`, `medication.changed`, `dose.recorded`, `appointment.changed`,
`reminder.changed`, `checkin.done`, `checkin.missed` (worker, every 5 min), `sos.raised`. **Notification templates:**
`care.readings_reviewed`, `safety.sos_raised`. **Worker:** `ensure_partitions` daily (4 months ahead),
`rebuild_summaries` nightly, `missed_checkins` every 5 minutes.

## 7. As built — devices and the hub contract (wave 3, 23 Oct 2026)

`services/api/app/devices` (models, service, contract, ingest, seed, jobs) with routers `app/api/hub.py` (`/hub/*`) and
`app/api/hubs.py` (people and staff). `tests/test_hub_contract.py` ports hms-stub's contract tests and adds the access
rules; `services/hub-core/tests/test_cure_global.py` runs hub-core's sync against the API in-process.

**Compatibility (ADR-0007).** Every hms-stub route keeps its path, body, response shape, status codes and error
`detail` strings; errors on `/hub/*` are `{"detail": "…"}` (not problem+json) because hub-core branches on them
(`pending`, `revoked`, `already_paired`, `Patient not in this household`, `no_consent`, `Prescription not found`).
Per-item batch reasons stay hms-stub's: `kind_not_enabled`, `bad_context`, `out_of_range`, `bad_recorded_at`
(plus ours: `not_permitted`, `consent_required`, `unit_not_allowed`, `proxy_not_permitted`, `not_in_household`).
`x-access` gains `device` (device JWT or the Ed25519 proof of possession).

**Device identity (E2-06).** `POST /hub/pairing/start {serial, public_key, fw}` (serial provisioned or on
`HUB_SERIAL_ALLOWLIST`; a factory key is pinned; 409 `already_paired` while active) → `{pairing_code, expires_in 600,
device_id, pair_url}` · `POST /hub/pairing/claim {code, family_id?}` (user token; the family's owner or an admin) →
`{device_id, household_id, household_name, family_id, family_name}` · `POST /hub/auth/challenge {serial}` → `{nonce,
expires_in 60}` · `POST /hub/auth/token {serial, nonce, signature}` → device JWT (EdDSA, `typ=device`, `sub` device,
`fam` family, 15 min) + rotating refresh `<id>.<secret>` (30 d) · `POST /hub/auth/refresh` (a reused token revokes
every refresh token of the hub) · `POST /hub/heartbeat {fw, uptime_s, cpu_temp_c, storage_free_mb, queue_len,
peripherals, sync_lag_s?, hub_backend_version?, catalogue_version?}`. The device row is read on every call, so a
revoked hub gets 403 `revoked` at once; 120 requests a minute per device.

**Members (E15-02).** `GET /hub/members` → `{household, family, members[…], catalogue_version}`; each member has the
HMS fields (`patient_id, display_name, first_name, relationship, role, language, is_child` (< digital-consent age),
`avatar_color, birth_year, vital_parameters, programme, guardian_patient_ids, consents, targets, photo`) plus
`person_id, family_role, sort_order, life_stage, sub_stage, age_band, overlays, is_infant, face_enrollable,
active_modules[{code, name, kind, hub_opt_in, categories, metrics, trackers, i18n_key}], metrics[{code, kind, unit,
display_unit, decimals, value_type, i18n_key}], trackers` (the catalogue's `hub_quick_log` ones), `checkin_enabled,
hub_display, proxy_for[person ids], family_view[{patient_id, categories, modules, vital_kinds, basis}]`.
`vital_parameters` = the membership's hub kinds kept to metrics an active hub-visible module records. `proxy_for`:
a parent or legal guardian of a child under the digital-consent age, a health proxy or designated carer, or a
`record` grant — decided by the policy for the member as a user. `family_view`: co-members whose hub-safe modules the
member may read (share_with_family grant to `family_role:<family>:admin`, guardianship, personal grants).

**Reads.** `GET /hub/members/{pid}/snapshot?days=90` → HMS `{patient_id, latest, series, targets}` with per point
`id, source_detail, estimated, validated, method, module_code, device{kind, device_id, peripheral_id, validated}`, and
`daily{kind: […]}`, `sparkline{kind: 14 × {date, mean, mean2}}`, `latest[kind].status` · `GET
/hub/members/{pid}/series/{kind}?days=1..366&context=` → the brief §5.3 series (`sugar` → glucose; aggregated past 200
points) + `device` per point · `GET …/medications` (medication_out, HMS fields) · `GET …/doses?dose_date=` →
`{date, taken[], slots[{prescription_id, dose_slot, state}]}` · `PUT …/doses {prescription_id, dose_date, dose_slot,
taken}` (idempotent set; 404 when not a scheduled slot) · `POST …/doses/toggle` · `GET …/appointments` (status
`booked` → `confirmed`; clinic notes left off) · `GET …/queue` · `GET …/photo` (only with biometric_face +
profile_photo in force; `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Photo-Version`) · `GET /hub/catalogue` (hub-safe and opt-in
modules, metrics, trackers with `i18n_key`).

**Writes.** `POST /hub/members/{pid}/vitals:batch` (≤ 50; observations with `source=hub`, `device_id`, module
`core.vitals` unless the item names a hub-visible one; `measured_for` / `entered_by` for proxy measurement — stored for
the dependant with `identified_by=proxy`, `entered_by_user_id` and an audit event naming who measured; `method:
"infant_difference"` with `combined_value` / `parent_value` or the difference as `value` — only the difference is
stored, labelled, with no raw payload) · `POST …/trackers:batch` (hub quick logs only, else `not_on_hub`) · `POST
…/consent {purpose: biometric_face|profile_photo, withdrawn?, granted_by_patient_id?}` (a child's from a guardian;
`health_data` only withdrawn on the hub) · `POST …/checkins {method: hub_tap|hub_voice, identified_by?, feeling?,
client_id}` (HZ-09; 409 when the module is off) · `POST /hub/sos {patient_id?, client_id}` (with a member: their
`sos_event`; without: notification `safety.sos_raised_hub` to every owner/admin, topic `hub.sos_raised`; a retried
client id never alarms twice) · `POST /hub/guest-claims` → `{claim_code, expires_in 900, claim_uri}`.

**Due today and reviews (E15-05).** `GET /hub/members/{pid}/due` → `{date, counts{medicines{due, done}, checkin,
vaccines, visits, checks{due, done}, total_due}, medicines[], checkin, vaccines[{code, vaccine, dose, due_on, state}],
visits[], checks[{kind, metric, done, n}]}` — counts for the shared Ambient screen, details after sign-in. Vaccines come
from the national schedule window (last 4 weeks, next 2) until immunisation records exist. `GET
…/reviews/latest` → `{review: {reviewer_name, reviewed_at, metrics, kinds, period, has_message} | null}` — the message
stays in the app.

**People and staff.** `GET /me/hubs` (hubs of families I own or administer) · `DELETE /hubs/{id}` · `POST
/hub-claims/{code}` (a guest reading into my own record, once) · `GET /admin/hubs?status=&online=&query=&cursor=&limit=`
→ `{items, next_cursor, summary{total, by_status, online, offline, firmware, sync_lag_bands, per_day[30]}}` · `GET
/admin/hubs/{id}?days=` → `{device, daily, recent, events}` · `POST /admin/hubs {serial, public_key?}` (provision) ·
`POST /admin/hubs/{id}/revoke {reason}` · dev only: `POST /auth/dev/hub-owner {serial}` (tokens for the owner of the
family the serial is provisioned for, for hub-core's pairing helper).

**Topics** `hub.paired`, `hub.revoked`, `hub.sos_raised`; template `safety.sos_raised_hub` (params `family_id`,
`device_id`). **Worker** `prune_devices` hourly (heartbeats after 30 days, spent nonces, codes, refresh tokens,
unclaimed guest readings).

## 8. As built — doctor console, alerts, live events, child health, exports (wave 3, 23 Oct 2026)

Every person-level route decides per record under the record's module (as §6); alerts and notes add their own rules
(below). Response models: `services/api/app/api/schemas_clinical.py`.

**Worklist and panel (E17-01).** `GET /clinician/worklist?family=&module=&programme=` → `{practitioner, generated_at,
review_interval_days, persons, counts{urgent, attention, info, due_review, new_data, target_outdated}, items[{kind: alert |
due_review | new_data | target_outdated, person{id, display_name, given_name, family_name, age_years, life_stage, sex},
family{id, name}, metric, alert_id, severity, status, module_code, since, summary_code (alert.<template> | review.due |
data.new | target.outdated), counts{…}, alert}]}`, ordered urgent → attention → info alerts (oldest first) → due for review
(no review in the doctor's interval, with readings) → new data since the last review → targets older than 12 months
(HZ-02). `GET /clinician/panel?query=&tag=` → `{practitioner, items[{person, family, programmes[], tags[] (mine),
categories[], deceased, last_review{at, practitioner_id, by_me}, adherence_pct (30 d), open_alerts{urgent, attention, info,
total}, metrics[{metric, display_unit, latest{…point, status, safety_net}}]}]}` · `GET/PATCH /clinician/me`
(`availability_text`, `response_time_hours`, `review_interval_days`, `notification_preferences{urgent|attention|info:
[push|email|in_app]}`) · `PUT /persons/{id}/clinician-tags {tags}` (covering clinician; private to them).

**Notes (E17-02).** `GET /persons/{id}/notes?include_history=` · `POST /persons/{id}/notes {body, title, visibility:
care_team | shared_with_subject | shared_with_family_viewers, kind, module_code (default core.care_plan)}` (a covering
clinician with clinical_notes and the module's sensitive categories; a therapist under a module she covers) ·
`GET /notes/{id}` (+ `history`) · `PATCH /notes/{id} {reason, body?, visibility?, title?}` (author only; a new version,
the old one superseded). Sharing notifies `care.note_shared` (ids only; never a guardian for a teen-confidential note).

**Alerts (E13).** `GET /persons/{id}/alert-rules` → `{items (explicit rules), builtin (in force, with params and
applies_because), templates (the caller may set)}` · `POST /persons/{id}/alert-rules {template_code, params, severity?,
enabled, metric?, module_code?, note?}` (replaces that template + metric) · `DELETE /alert-rules/{id}` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/alerts?status=open|acknowledged|resolved|expired|active&cursor=` → `{items[{id, person_id, family_id,
rule_id, template_code, summary_code, trigger_type, trigger_ref, module_code, metric, severity, audience: care_team | family
| both, status, opened_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by{kind, id, name}, resolved_at, resolution, escalation_step,
next_escalation_at, firing{record ids, value(s), rule, threshold (clinicians only), safety_net, repeats}, description,
synthetic}], next_cursor}` · `GET /alerts/{id}` (+ `history`) · `POST /alerts/{id}/acknowledge` (stops the chain) ·
`POST /alerts/{id}/resolve {resolution}`. Templates: `urgent_band` (always), `target_attention`, `pregnancy_bp` (+ the
built-in `pregnancy_bp_safety_net`, HZ-04), `weight_gain` (heart-failure programme), `missed_readings` (programmes),
`seizure_duration` (HZ-11), `missed_checkin`, `inactivity` (E11-07), `sos`. Clinical alerts reach the care team only;
families get the safety alerts (and `both`). **Escalation:** `GET/PUT /families/{id}/escalation {steps[{recipient{type:
person | family_admins | contact | subject_emergency_contact, person_id?, contact_id?}, channels[push|sms|email|in_app],
after_minutes}], quiet_hours{start, end, urgent_exempt}}` (owner/admin; `If-Match` `W/"esc-<n>"`); default chain:
owners/admins + guardians by push. **Push tokens:** `POST/DELETE /push-tokens {token: ExponentPushToken[…], platform}`.
**Ops:** `GET /admin/notifications/stats?days=` (per channel × day: sent, delivered, failed, skipped; failure %; queue;
recent failures with error codes) · `GET/POST /admin/alerts/synthetic` (the daily synthetic alert test and its history).

**Live updates (E17-06).** `POST /events/token?stream=` → `{token (60 s), expires_in, url}` ·
`GET /events?stream=practitioner|family&token=&max_seconds=` (`text/event-stream`; Bearer or the token; `Last-Event-ID`
resumes). Events: `ready`, `observation.created`, `alert.opened|acknowledged|escalated|resolved|updated`,
`review.created`, `note.created`, `worklist.changed` (practitioner); also `tracker.created`, `checkin.done|missed`,
`sos.raised`, `dose.recorded`, `immunization.recorded` (family). `data` = `{type, person_id, <record>_id, metric_code,
tracker_code, module_code, severity, template_code, step}` — ids and codes only, each event decided by the policy.

**Child health (E8).** `POST /families/{id}/newborns {given_name?, born_at | birth_date, sex_for_clinical_use, weight_kg,
length_cm, head_circumference_cm, gestational_age_weeks/days, other_parent_person_id, mother_person_id, display_name}` →
identity + `birth`, `guardianships`, `observations`, `modules_active`, `care_team{covered_by, prompt: add_paediatrician |
null, suggestions}`, `mother_episode` · `GET /persons/{id}/growth?metric=weight|height|length|head_circumference|bmi&
reference=placeholder` → `{metric, measure, unit, sex, reference{key, id, label, placeholder, watermark, source},
reference_available, birth{date, gestational_age_weeks, preterm, corrected_age_until_days}, interpretation, audience:
clinician | family, points[{id, t, age_days, corrected_age_days, v, source, module_code, derived, z, percentile}],
curves[{z, points[{age_days, value}]}] (z −3…+3; `z` null for families), settings}` · `PUT /persons/{id}/growth-settings
{family_interpretation}` (clinician) · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/immunizations` · `POST /immunizations/{id}/verify
{document_id?}` · `POST /persons/{id}/immunizations:verify-bulk {document_id, immunization_ids}` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/immunizations/due` → `{schedule{code, country, version, status, source}, draft, items[{code, vaccine,
dose, due_on, window_until, school_grade, status: given | overdue | due | upcoming | later, given_on, immunization_id,
verification, schedule_item_verified, note}], counts}` · `GET/POST /persons/{id}/milestones` (placeholder items per
checkpoint × domain until the content licence; `content_url`).

**Elder and exports.** `GET /persons/{id}/elder-summary` → `{checkins{visible, streak_days, done_30d, missed_30d, …},
falls{visible, count, injuries, items}, adherence{visible, pct}, polypharmacy{visible, active_count, flag (≥ 5)},
beers_flags: null (R2)}` · `GET /persons/{id}/report.pdf?from=&to=` (reportlab; charts with the person's own target bands)
· `GET /persons/{id}/export/fhir?from=&to=` (`application/fhir+json`, Bundle `collection`: Patient, Observation with
vital-signs profiles and a module tag, Condition ICD-11, AllergyIntolerance, MedicationStatement, Immunization). Both
audited as `export`; staff only inside break-glass.

**Outbox topics added:** `alert.opened`, `alert.updated`, `alert.escalated`, `alert.acknowledged`, `alert.resolved`,
`note.created`, `note.amended`, `immunization.recorded`, `milestone.answered`, `person.newborn`, `episode.changed`.
**Notification templates added** (`app/notifications/templates.py`, en/si/ta; si/ta drafts for native review): `alert.sos`,
`alert.missed_checkin`, `alert.inactivity`, `alert.seizure_duration`, `alert.pregnancy_bp_safety_net`, `alert.check_on`
(SMS to an external contact), `alert.acknowledged`, `alert.clinical_urgent`, `alert.clinical_attention`,
`care.note_shared`, `care.newborn_added`, `synthetic.test`. **Worker:** `dispatch_outbox` (twice a minute),
`escalate_alerts` and `deliver_notifications` (every minute), `scheduled_rules` (hourly), `synthetic_alert_test` (03:00).

## 9. As built — R2 part A: maternity, women's health, consent R2, messages, questionnaires, share links (wave 5, 23 Oct 2026)

Routers `app/api/{maternity,women,consent_r2,messaging,questionnaires,sharelinks}.py`; models in
`app/api/schemas_r2a.py`. Every person-level route decides under the module it shows (§6); a module, thread, episode or
link the caller may not see answers **404** (no trace). Contexts: `app/maternity`, `app/women`, `app/messaging`,
`app/questionnaires`, `app/sharelinks`, and `app/consent/{access_log,teen,safety_concern,capacity}.py`.

**Maternity (E9-01..E9-09).** `POST /persons/{id}/episodes {type: pregnancy, dating: lmp|scan, lmp?, scan_date?, scan_weeks?,
scan_days?, edd?, gravida?, para?}` → episode (`started_on` = the LMP-equivalent, `edd` = +280 d; one active pregnancy,
409 `episode-active`). Who: she herself, or a covering clinician with reproductive-health write; **under the
digital-consent age only a clinician on her care team** (doctor/midwife/nurse) — 403 `clinician-only` otherwise — which
puts the pregnancy/postpartum modules on a **safeguarding hold** (HZ-19: the recording clinician only, the lead through
break-glass), opens the `safeguarding_review` task and tells the clinical safety officers (`safeguarding.review_needed`,
ids only) · `GET /persons/{id}/episodes` · `PATCH /episodes/{id} {re-dating, gravida, para, targets_declined,
targets_declined_reason, safeguarding_decision: reopen|keep}` (decline: her obstetrician; reopen: the recording
clinician) · `GET /persons/{id}/pregnancy` → `{episode, gestation{total_days, weeks, days}, trimester, days_to_edd,
week{week, trimester, content_key: pregnancy.week.<n>, placeholder, cso_status}, weeks[4..42], anc{schedule, contacts[{number,
week, due_on, window_from, window_until, status: done|booked|due|upcoming|not_recorded, appointment_id}], next_visit,
reminders}, targets{status: set|declined|pending|no_obstetrician, metrics, deadline (created + 7 d), overdue, obstetricians},
safety_net{active, reason: no_obstetrician|targets_pending|targets_declined, text_id: safety.pregnancy_bp,
warning_symptoms, not_monitored, contacts (clinic/PHM/MOH/hospital), prompt: add_external_contact|null, emergency_number,
threshold (clinicians only)}, movements{from_week 24, text_id, kick_counts: false, reports}, modules, hub_display (hers)}`.
Antenatal contacts come from the country pack's `anc` schedule (LK: placeholder weeks 8, 12, 20, 26, 30, 34, 36, 38, 40 —
⚠ FHB to confirm), a visit within ±10 days counting · `POST /episodes/{id}/reduced-movements {note?, contacted_unit?,
client_id?}` (HZ-05) → `{text_id: safety.reduced_movements, contact (her own maternity contact), emergency_number,
care_team_told}` + a `fetal_movement_concern` entry + an urgent `reduced_movements` care-team alert (idempotent) ·
`POST /episodes/{id}/birth` (the mother, her own record; NewbornIn fields + `family_id?`; GA from the EDD when missing) →
the newborn response (`app/child/newborn.py` with `require_manager=False`) + `stopped` · `POST /episodes/{id}/end
{outcome: loss|other, ended_on?}` → `{episode, stopped{hub_cards, reminders, visits_cancelled, messages_cancelled,
alerts_resolved}, follow_up (pregnancy.loss.follow_up, placeholder), modules_active}`; pregnancy hub_display consents are
withdrawn (reason `episode_ended`, nobody told), future pregnancy visits cancelled, queued messages with the episode id
cancelled, `loss_follow_up` task (hers only), `care.follow_up_suggested` to her obstetrician · `GET
/persons/{id}/postpartum` → `{episode, days_since_birth, visits{schedule (postnatal.LK), items[{kind: phm_visit|clinic_visit,
from, until, count, recorded, status}]}, checkins{questionnaire: wellbeing_checkin, non_validated, items (score: clinicians
only)}, recovery{bp, weight, temperature}, content}` · staff: `GET /admin/safeguarding` (CSO/super admin; metadata only).
Pregnancy BP refuses `wrist_cuff`/`cuffless`/`estimated`/`wrist_optical` readings: per-item reason **`method_not_allowed`** (HZ-08).

**Women's health (E10-01, E10-03, E10-04).** `GET /persons/{id}/cycle?months=1..24` → `{periods[{start, end, days,
heaviest_flow, mean_pain}], cycle_lengths (values only), average_cycle_days, average_period_days, last_period_start,
days_since_last_start, prediction{estimate: true, next_start, window_from, window_until, based_on_cycles} (≥ 2 cycles),
flow_counts, symptom_counts, calendar (92 days), privacy{private, hub: false, third_party_analytics: false,
teen_confidential}, shared_with (hers: clinicians via care team or grant)}`; a device actor gets 403 · `GET
/persons/{id}/menopause?days=7..366` → `{daily, weekly[{week_start, days_logged, hot_flushes, night_sweat_nights,
sleep_quality_mean, mood_mean, bleeding_days}], last_period, days_since_last_period, privacy, shared_with}` · `GET
/persons/{id}/screening` → `{schedule, items[{code: cervical|breast, module_code, status: due|upcoming|overdue|done|not_due,
due_on, window_until, last_done_on, at_ages, interval_years, missed_rounds, verified}], reminders}` from the pack's
`screening` schedule (LK Well Woman Clinic rounds; INTL USPSTF intervals; ⚠ CSO); a completed visit or a document filed
under the screening module counts as done.

**Consent R2.** `GET /persons/{id}/access-log?from=&to=&cursor=&limit=&include_own=` (E4-06) → `{view: self|guardian|own_only|
dpo, teen_confidential_hidden, items[{id, at, action, resource_type, purpose, basis, actor{type, name, role, id (DPO)},
resource_id/details (DPO)}], next_cursor}` — guardians of a teen in the confidentiality years see no event marked
`details.tc` (set by `AccessContext.require` for sensitive/teen-confidential modules), no non-neutral event without the
flag, and none of the teen's own; a family admin of an adult sees their own accesses; `dpo_auditor` everything ·
`POST /persons/{id}/teen-confidentiality {module_codes}` (the 13–15-year-old; teen-confidential modules only) · `GET
/persons/{id}/teen-confidentiality` (the teen or a covering clinician) · `POST /teen-confidentiality/{id}/approve|decline`
(a doctor on the care team) → approval writes the `teen_confidentiality` consent `{modules, approved_by_practitioner_id,
request_id}`; the policy then hides those modules (only) from guardians; consents with that purpose never show to a
guardian · `POST /admin/persons/{id}/safety-concern {restricted_person_ids, reason}` (ops_support/super_admin, E4-09) →
`{restrictions, grants_revoked, notifications_cancelled}`; `GET /admin/persons/{id}/safety-concerns` (+ dpo_auditor) ·
`POST /admin/safety-restrictions/{id}/end` · `POST /persons/{id}/capacity-decisions {kind: assessment|best_interest, outcome:
lacks_capacity|has_capacity|best_interest_decided, purposes, assessed_on, review_on (≤ 183 d with location_tracking, ≤ 366 d
otherwise), reason ≥ 10 chars, evidence_document_id?}` (covering clinician or health proxy; adults) · `GET
/persons/{id}/capacity-decisions`. A `best_interest_proxy` consent cites the latest covering decision
(`scope.capacity_decision_id`); for `location_tracking` there is none without one (409 `capacity-decision-required`).
**hub_display (E4-12)** stays `POST /persons/{id}/consents {purpose: hub_display, scope.module_code}` (hub_opt_in modules
only; teen-confidential → only her own consent); the purge is the hub's **`members_version`** (below).

**Messages (E17-07, E10-02).** `GET /threads?person_id=&status=` (a clinician's own threads; a family user's threads
about people whose messages they may read) · `POST /persons/{id}/threads {practitioner_id (family side), subject?, body,
module_code? (default core.messages; e.g. pregnancy.core), confidential? (teen.confidential_messages: 16–17, or 13–15
approved; she or her clinician), client_id?}` → `{thread, message}`; 422 `not-on-care-team` when the clinician doesn't
cover the person for that module · `GET /threads/{id}/messages?cursor=&limit=` (marks it read) · `POST
/threads/{id}/messages {body ≤ 4000, client_id?}` (idempotent) · `POST /threads/{id}/read`. Thread: `{id, person_id,
person_name, module_code, confidential, subject, status, created_at, last_message_at, unread, practitioner{id,
display_name, response_time_hours, availability_text}, not_for_emergencies: true, emergency_number}`; message: `{…, author_kind,
author_name, body, read, read_at}` (read receipts are per-thread watermarks). Notifications `message.new` ("New message
from your care team", the person or her guardians — each policy-checked) and `message.new_clinician`; SSE
**`message.created`** `{person_id, thread_id, message_id, module_code}` on both streams, decided per thread.

**Questionnaires (E8-06, E11-02).** `GET /questionnaires` (catalogue `questionnaires.yaml`: licence, validation, status,
modules, items; `scoring` for clinicians) · `POST /persons/{id}/questionnaires {questionnaire_code, module_code?, due_on?,
note?}` (covering clinician; **409 `licence-required`** for EPDS/PHQ-9/M-CHAT-R/F/GMFCS-E&R) · `GET
/persons/{id}/questionnaires?status=` · `POST /questionnaire-assignments/{id}/cancel` · `POST
/persons/{id}/questionnaire-responses {assignment_id | questionnaire_code (self_start only), module_code?, answers,
client_id?}` (the person or a guardian; per-item 422 errors; idempotent) · `GET /persons/{id}/questionnaire-responses?code=`
→ answers for whoever may read the module, **`score` and `score_detail` for clinicians only**. Shipped: `falls_risk_check`
(non-validated placeholder, elder.falls) and `wellbeing_checkin` (non-validated; core.questionnaires, or postpartum.core
during a postpartum episode), both `draft_needs_cso_signoff`.

**Share links (E19-02).** `POST /persons/{id}/share-links {scope: emergency_summary|vitals, metrics?, days?,
expires_in_hours? (1–720, default 72), label?}` (the person 16+, a guardian of a minor, a health proxy) → the link with
`token`, `url`, `api_path`, `qr_payload` (shown once; `SHARE_PUBLIC_URL`, default https://cure.lk/s) · `GET
/persons/{id}/share-links` · `DELETE /share-links/{id}` · **`GET /shared/{token}`** (x-access `public`; 30 reads per IP
per 5 min, 120 per link per hour; `Cache-Control: no-store`; unknown/expired/revoked → 404) → `{scope, label, expires_at,
read_only, person{display_name, given_name, family_name, age_years}, emergency{blood_group, conditions, allergies,
medications, contacts, emergency_number} | vitals{days, metrics[{metric, unit, points}]}, notice}`. The modules are
snapshotted at creation (sensitive ones only when the person made the link) and the creator's access is decided again at
every read; each read is audited (actor type `share_link`).

**Hub contract (additive, ADR-0007).** `POST /hub/heartbeat` and `GET /hub/members` gain **`members_version`** (`mv1-…`,
changes on any membership, consent, grant, guardianship, module state, target, safety restriction or person change, and
daily). hub-core (cure-global mode) heartbeats every `HUB_MEMBERS_CHECK_S` (30 s) and refreshes members — re-importing
histories and caches — whenever it changes; HMS mode is unchanged. `POST /hub/sos` without a member now also puts
`sos_ref` in its push params and outbox event.

**Alerts.** `hub.sos_raised` → a **family-level alert** (`person_id: null`, template `hub_sos`, audience family) that runs
the family's escalation chain, skipping the owners/admins pushed at the press; an external contact gets
`alert.check_on_home`. `GET /families/{id}/alerts?status=` (members); `GET /alerts/{id}`, `/acknowledge`, `/resolve` accept
family-level alerts for active family members. `AlertOut.person_id` is nullable. New built-in templates:
`reduced_movements` (care team, urgent) and `hub_sos`.

**Outbox topics added:** `message.created`, `questionnaire.assigned`, `questionnaire.completed` (plus `episode.changed`,
`hub.member_refresh`, `consent.given`, `grant.changed` from the new paths). **Notification templates added:** `message.new`,
`message.new_clinician`, `questionnaire.assigned`, `checkup.due`, `care.follow_up_suggested`, `safeguarding.review_needed`,
`teen.confidentiality_requested`, `teen.confidentiality_decided`, `alert.hub_sos`, `alert.check_on_home` (en/si/ta; si/ta
drafts). **Worker:** `care_reminders` daily 03:00 UTC (08:30 Colombo) — antenatal contacts a week ahead and screening
rounds, to the person only, once per contact/round (`params.reminder_key`).

## 10. As built — R2 part B: special needs, GPS and safety, overrides, content, duplicates, step-up (wave 5, 23 Oct 2026)

Routers: `app/api/special_needs.py`, `location.py`, `hub_r2b.py`, `admin_r2b.py`, `people_r2b.py`, `reauth.py`; models in
`app/api/schemas_r2b.py` (new routes) and `app/api/schemas_p1.py` (the P1/admin routes that returned untyped dicts now have
response models — nothing dropped, a few null fields added).

**Special needs (E12).** `GET/PUT /persons/{id}/care-profile` (`If-Match`/`ETag` `W/"cp-…"`; fixed sections about_me,
communication, sensory, behaviour_support, daily_living, mobility, emergency; a PUT replaces the sections given and keeps
the others; `history` of revisions) · `GET /persons/{id}/communication-passport` (the shareable summary built from what the
*caller* may read: contacts follow the contact rules, recorded allergies need conditions & allergies) ·
`GET /persons/{id}/communication-passport.pdf` · `POST /persons/{id}/communication-passport/share {hours ≤ 168, audience}` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/patterns?tracker=behaviour_abc|sleep_diary_day&weeks=1..26` → `by_weekday`, `by_time_of_day`, `heatmap`
(weekday × night/morning/afternoon/evening/late_evening), `antecedents`, `consequences`, `triggers`, `weekly`, `trend`
(behaviour) or weekly sleep onset/duration/wakings/latency and their trend (sleep) — counts and means, no interpretation ·
`GET/PUT /persons/{id}/visual-schedule {title, routines[{key, title, starts_at, days, steps[{key, label, picture_key, time,
timer_minutes}], first_then{first, then}}]}` (versioned, `If-Match` `W/"vs-<person>-<version>"`, emits `hub.member_refresh`)
· `GET/POST /persons/{id}/therapy-goals` (POST: a covering practitioner with behaviour support only) ·
`PATCH /therapy-goals/{id}` · `GET/POST /therapy-goals/{id}/practice {client_entry_id, practised_at, done, minutes, note}`
(stored as a `therapy_session` tracker entry with `data.goal_id`; `created | duplicate | rejected`) ·
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/health-checks {item_code, done_on, note, client_id}` (the `ds_health_supervision` schedule; `cso_status`
and `schedule.draft` say it awaits CSO sign-off; 404 for someone the module doesn't apply to). Seizures: the existing
tracker batches (app and hub) fire `seizure_duration` with the doctor's `minutes` (HZ-11; tested from the hub).

**Hub contract (additive, ADR-0007).** `GET /hub/members/{pid}/visual-schedule` → `{patient_id, version, title, routines,
today{date, weekday, local_time, routines[{key, current_step, starts_at}]}, updated_at}` (404 `Not enabled` otherwise) ·
`GET /hub/members/{pid}/location-status` → `{patient_id, status: at_home | at_usual_place | away | offline | unknown |
no_tracker, since, place_kind, battery_low}` only with the person's `hub_display` opt-in for `elder.safety_gps`; never
coordinates.

**GPS and safety (E11-03..E11-05).** `GET/POST /persons/{id}/tracker-devices {unique_id, kind, protocol, model}` (needs
`elder.safety_gps` active and a `location_tracking` consent in force — a health proxy's `best_interest_proxy` consent is the
best-interest basis; 409 `module-inactive` / `consent-required` / `tracker-registered`) · `DELETE /tracker-devices/{id}` ·
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/geofences {name, kind, shape: circle | polygon, center, radius_m 25–5000, points, alert_on_exit,
alert_on_enter, alert_after_minutes 0–120, schedule{from, to}, active}` · `PATCH/DELETE /geofences/{id}` ·
`GET /persons/{id}/location-events?type=&from=&to=&cursor=` · `GET /persons/{id}/last-location` (live from Traccar when
reachable, else the last event's position; `inside[]` = the person's places; audited; the person gets
`safety.location_viewed`) · `GET/PUT /persons/{id}/wandering-plan` (+ `preview`) · `GET /persons/{id}/wandering-plan.pdf` ·
`POST /persons/{id}/wandering-plan/share {hours ≤ 72, audience}` → `{id, token, url, pdf_url, expires_at}` (token shown
once; the person's guardians and family owners/admins get `safety.plan_shared`) · `GET /persons/{id}/summary-shares` ·
`DELETE /summary-shares/{id}` · public: `GET /shared-summaries/{token}` (+ `/pdf`, `/photo` while profile_photo consent
lasts; rate-limited per address; every view audited as actor `public`). All under `location_safety` / `elder.safety_gps`:
the person, guardians/proxy and carers with a location & safety grant read; writes need write (self, guardian, proxy,
designated carer, record grant). Family owners/admins without a grant get the alerts only.

**Traccar webhook.** `POST /internal/traccar/events` (`X-Traccar-Secret`) — Traccar's forwarded `{event, position, device,
geofence}`: device by `device.uniqueId` (keyed hash) or Traccar id → `location_event` (dedupe on the Traccar event id) →
`location.event`. Types: geofenceExit/Enter, alarm sos | fall/fallDown | lowBattery/lowPower, deviceOffline/Online;
everything else and unknown devices → 204 and dropped. **Alerts** (templates `geofence_exit` attention, `fall_detected`
attention, `device_battery` info — family audience, in `SAFETY_TEMPLATES`; watch SOS becomes an `sos_event` source `watch`
and the existing `sos` alert): an exit waits the place's `alert_after_minutes` inside its hours (worker), coming back cancels
or resolves it (`returned`); low battery once per tracker per local day; acknowledgement stops the chain; a neighbour's SMS
never for `device_battery`. REST client `app/location/traccar.py` (TRACCAR_URL, TRACCAR_EMAIL/PASSWORD or TRACCAR_TOKEN;
opaque names `cg-<id>`, `cg-gf-<id>`; lat-first WKT `CIRCLE (lat lon, r)`); unset URL = no client (registrations stay
`pending`). Topics `tracker_device.changed`, `location.event`.

**Polypharmacy (E11-06).** `GET /persons/{id}/polypharmacy-review` (practitioners with medication only) →
`{active_count, threshold 5, flag, medicines[{…, flags}], flags[{rule_code, kind: avoid | caution | interaction |
combination, severity, text, medicine_ids, medicine_names, cso_status}], criteria{id, version, status, source, min_age,
placeholder}}` from `app/clinical/beers_placeholder.yaml` (a PLACEHOLDER list, CSO to replace). `elder-summary.beers_flags`
is that list for practitioners, `null` for everyone else.

**Catalogue overrides (E6-06).** `GET /admin/catalogue/overrides?status=` · `POST /admin/catalogue/overrides {scope: global |
country | organization, scope_id, module_code, field: enabled | default_state | age_band, value, reason}` (draft with
`impact`) · `POST …/{id}/preview` → `{persons_in_scope, persons_changed, transitions[{from, to, n}], suppressed}` (counts
only) · `POST …/{id}/review {decision}` (clinical_safety_officer; not the author) · `POST …/{id}/activate` (super_admin;
re-resolves everyone in scope) · `POST …/{id}/retire`. The resolver applies active overrides (organisation > country >
global; an organisation applies through a covering practitioner's organisation); modules with `opt_out: false` can't be
switched off.

**Content (E18-06).** `GET/POST /admin/content` · `GET/PATCH /admin/content/{id}` (a published/approved item opens a new
draft version) · `POST …/{id}/submit` (source required; notification templates and safety-net texts pass the
no-health-data scan, else 422 `content-health-data`) · `POST …/{id}/review {approve | request_changes}` (CSO, not the
author) · `POST …/{id}/translations/{si|ta}/review {decision, reviewer_name}` · `POST …/{id}/publish` · `POST …/{id}/retire`
· `GET /content?kind=&locale=&module_code=&code=` (authenticated: published items, in the locale only when its review is
approved, else English). `GET /admin/queues` → badge counts.

**People admin (E3-06, E3-11) and console gaps.** `GET /admin/duplicates?status=` (both records side by side: names, birth
year, families, record counts) · `POST /admin/duplicates/scan` · `POST …/{id}/dismiss {reason}` · `POST …/{id}/request-merge
{keep_person_id, reason}` (asks an owner/admin of every family involved and each adult record holder; notification
`person.merge_review_requested`) · `POST …/{id}/merge` (all approved; step-up) · family side `GET /me/merge-requests`,
`POST /merge-requests/{consent_id}/decide {approve | decline}` · `GET /admin/care-links?family_id=&practitioner_id=&status=`
(sensitive person-level links: `role: "clinician"`, `sensitive: true`) · `POST /admin/care-links/{id}/end {reason}` ·
`GET /admin/persons?query=` (name, display name, login phone/email or NIC/PHN/passport by keyed hash; no DOB) ·
`GET /admin/guardianships/{id}/evidence`, `GET /admin/practitioners/{id}/evidence` (5-minute signed links, audited) ·
`POST /practitioners/me/evidence` (raw body) · `GET /evidence/{id}/download?exp=&sig=`. `GET /admin/families/{id}`:
`account.id` (= `user_account_id`, the support-action target) and `hubs[]` (device_out). Break-glass outputs add
`subject_name`, `requested_by_name`, `approved_by_name`, `ended_by_name`, `reviewed_by_name`, `reviewed_at`. Care-request
lists add `family_name`, `person_display_name`, `practitioner_name`. Problem `errors[].loc` is always an array. Series
`modules` lists only modules in use for the person or holding readings of the metric. A minor mother registers her baby
herself (`POST /families/{id}/newborns` by a plain member when she is the named mother); anyone else naming a mother under
18 gets 403 `minor-mother`; under 16 → 409 `safeguarding-review`; a `parent` guardian under 16 starts `pending`.

**Step-up (ACCESS_CONTROL.md §9).** Doctors and staff (not family users, not dev actors) get 403 `reauth-required`
(`action`, `max_age_seconds`) unless the session signed in, or re-authenticated, in the last 10 minutes — for PDF/FHIR
exports, the wandering-plan and passport PDFs and shares, break-glass request/approve, bulk target changes (> 1 item),
completing a DSAR, merges and evidence views. `POST /auth/reauth {password, code | recovery_code}` → `{access_token (claim
sua), session_id, step_up_expires_at}` (wrong answers: 403 `reauth-failed`, never 401). **`X-Access-Purpose`** (clinicians):
treatment (default) · care_coordination · emergency · quality_review, recorded as the audit purpose; unknown → 400
`bad-purpose`; ignored for other actors.

**Worker:** `location_jobs` (every minute: exit waits, Traccar sync), `scan_duplicates` (nightly). **Notification
templates added:** `alert.geofence_exit`, `alert.fall_detected`, `alert.device_battery`, `safety.location_viewed`,
`safety.plan_shared`, `person.merge_review_requested`, `person.records_merged`. **Topics:** `location.event`,
`tracker_device.changed`, `person.merged`.

## 11. As built — R3: programmes, organisations, billing, HMS, SMART on FHIR, IPS, wearables (wave 5, 23 Oct 2026)

New contexts `app/programmes`, `app/orgs`, `app/billing`, `app/hms`, `app/smart`, `app/wearables` (+ `app/exports/fhir_read.py`,
`app/exports/ips.py`); routers `app/api/{programmes,orgs,billing,hms,smart_apps,wearables,fhir_api}.py`, response models
`app/api/schemas_r3.py`. Migration 0008 (DATA_MODEL.md §16). Every JSON response now says `charset=utf-8`
(`app/platform/charset.py`: the panel's "°C" arrived as "Â°C" in charset-guessing clients).

**Programmes (chronic care).** Packs are catalogue data (`packages/module-catalogue/catalogue/programme_packs/*.yaml`, schema
`programme_pack.schema.json`, all `draft_needs_clinical_signoff`): metrics, outcomes (`mean_7d` | `latest` | `change_7d` |
`count_7d`), alert rules (`builtin` — the engine reads missed-readings and weight-gain defaults from the packs — or `rule`, created
when the clinician applies the pack), target templates (absolute, or `relative_to: personal_best` for peak-flow zones), the review
cadence and coordinator tasks. `GET /programmes` · `GET /programmes/{code}` · `POST /persons/{id}/programmes {code,
organization_id?, coordinator_practitioner_id?, apply_pack?, targets[{template, personal_best?}], review_interval_days?}` (wave-1
body still valid; answer adds `enrolment`) · `GET /persons/{id}/programmes` (items add `enrolment`) · `DELETE /programmes/{id}`
(ends the enrolment, expires its open tasks) · `GET /programmes/{code}/cohort?org=` (practitioner on the care team; with `org`,
only that organisation's enrolments and you must practise there) → `{programme, totals{persons, review_overdue, review_due_soon,
weight_gain_open, missed_readings_open, open_tasks}, items[{person, view: full|summary, enrolment, outcomes[{code, metric,
measure, v, v2, previous_v, change, change2, from_v, at, n, status, display_unit}], weight_gain_events{days, count, open},
adherence_pct_30d, missed_readings{days, days_without_reading, open_alerts}, attention_alerts_30d, review{last_review_at,
next_due_on, days_left, status: overdue|due_soon|scheduled}, open_tasks}]}` · `GET /programmes/{code}/outcomes?org=&weeks=` →
per outcome metric, per ISO week: `persons`, `mean`, `mean2`, `within_target`, `with_target` · `GET
/persons/{id}/programmes/{code}/outcomes?weeks=` → weekly `{n, mean, mean2, min, max}` per metric + the person's target + weekly
adherence (chart data) · `GET /programmes/{code}/tasks?org=&status=&mine=` · `POST /programme-tasks/{id}/complete {status:
done|skipped, outcome: reached|no_answer|booked|escalated|not_needed, note}` (note encrypted). Measured readings only; status
from the person's own target. **Worker:** `programme_tasks` daily 07:00 Colombo (idempotent per task × enrolment × period).

**Coordinator scope (ACCESS_CONTROL.md §2.2, §11).** A `coordinator` care-team member reads vitals only as summaries
(`Request.summary`: cohort and outcome endpoints), medication read-only (adherence), appointments and messages; individual
readings, notes, documents, targets and alert rules are refused.

**Organisations (E5-06).** `GET /orgs/mine` (`is_admin`, `practitioner_role`) · `GET /orgs/{id}` (its admins and active
practitioners) · `PATCH /orgs/{id} {branding_name, country_code, default_language, settings}` · `GET /orgs/{id}/overview`
(practitioners by role/status, programmes with enrolment counts suppressed under 5, open invites, open tasks) · `GET
/orgs/{id}/practitioners` (+ `invites`) · `POST /orgs/{id}/practitioners/invite {email, display_name, role}` (email with a
7-day link; `token` in the answer in dev/test only) · `DELETE /org-invites/{id}` · `POST /org-invites/accept {token}` (the
invited, signed-in practitioner account — the account email must match) · `PATCH /orgs/{id}/practitioners/{role_id} {role,
active}` (deactivating clears their coordinator assignments in the org) · `GET /orgs/{id}/programmes` · `PUT
/orgs/{id}/programmes/{code} {status, default_coordinator_practitioner_id, clear_coordinator, review_interval_days}`. An org
admin is a `staff_role` with `organization_id` (granted with `POST /admin/staff-roles`); as staff they get no PHI and can't
request break-glass (`PLATFORM_ROLES`).

**Billing (E21).** Plans (placeholders): `free` (6 members, 1 hub, 3 PDF reports / 30 days, no wearables, no HMS), `family`,
`family_plus`, `clinic_programme` (organisation, per seat). `GET /billing/plans` · `GET /families/{id}/billing` (owner/admin)
→ `{plan, subscription, read_only, entitlements, usage}` · `POST /families/{id}/checkout {plan_code, gateway?}` (owner;
`Idempotency-Key`) → `{id, url, …}` · `POST /families/{id}/subscription/cancel` (at period end; then Free) · `GET
/families/{id}/invoices` · `POST /orgs/{id}/checkout {plan_code: clinic_programme, programme_code, seats}` · `GET
/orgs/{id}/billing` · dev only: `GET /billing/fake-gateway/{ref}`, `POST /billing/fake-gateway/{ref}/complete {outcome,
decline_renewals}` · `POST /internal/billing/webhooks/{gateway}` (not public; HMAC `t=…,v1=…` for fake/Stripe, `md5sig` for
PayHere; idempotent by `(gateway, event id)`) · admin: `GET/POST /admin/billing/plans`, `PATCH /admin/billing/plans/{code}`,
`GET /admin/billing/subscriptions?status=&owner_type=` (+ `summary` by status), `GET /admin/billing/subscriptions/{id}`, `POST
/admin/billing/subscriptions/{id}/actions {action: extend_grace|cancel_now|reactivate|comp_period|lapse_now, days, reason}`,
`GET /admin/billing/invoices?status=`, `POST /admin/billing/invoices/{id}/void`, `POST /admin/billing/run`. **Gating:** hub
pairing claim (`{"detail": "plan_limit"}`, 402), PDF reports for family users, wearable connections, the HMS connector;
`billing.entitlements.require_entitlement(family, "gps_trackers", used)` is ready for tracker registration. **Read-only
(E21-03):** an app-wide dependency (`app/api/billing_guard.py`) refuses a family user's write on a lapsed person/family with 402
`https://cure.global/problems/read-only`; reads, every export, SOS, check-ins, consents/grants/family sharing, DSAR, unlinking
and paying stay open; clinicians and the hub are not blocked; an org-paid programme keeps its members writable. **Worker:**
`billing_run` hourly (renewals, retries on day 1/3/7, lapse after `BILLING_GRACE_DAYS`). Templates `billing.payment_failed`,
`billing.lapsed`, `billing.renewed`; topic `billing.subscription_changed`.

**HMS connector (E19-05).** `GET /persons/{id}/hms-link` → `{link, connector: fake|http|none}` · `POST
/persons/{id}/hms-link/start {display_id}` → pending link with `otp_sent_to` (HMS sends the code to its phone on file) · `POST
/persons/{id}/hms-link/confirm {link_id, otp}` → `{link, result}` (consent `hms_connector`, first import) · `POST
/persons/{id}/hms-link/sync` → per kind `created|updated|unchanged|rejected` (+ `matched`) · `DELETE /persons/{id}/hms-link` ·
`GET /admin/integrations/hms`. Imports: visits → completed appointments + clinic vitals (`source=clinic`, `source_app=hms`,
validated), prescriptions → medicines `source=hms` with times of day (a repeat of a medicine the family records is matched, never
duplicated or overwritten), appointments with queue numbers. HMS contract the client speaks: `app/hms/fake_server.py` docstring.
**Worker:** `hms_sync` every 6 h. Topics `hms.linked`, `hms.synced`.

**SMART App Launch 2.2 + FHIR read API (E19-04) + IPS (E19-03)** — at `/fhir/r4`, outside `/api/v1`: `GET /fhir/r4/metadata`
(CapabilityStatement) · `GET /fhir/r4/.well-known/smart-configuration` (and `/.well-known/smart-configuration`) · `GET
/fhir/r4/auth/authorize` (validates client, exact redirect URI, `aud`, PKCE S256, scopes; then 302 to `SMART_CONSENT_UI_URL`, or
JSON without one) · `POST /fhir/r4/auth/token` (form; authorization_code + `code_verifier`; Basic or `client_secret` for
confidential apps) → `{access_token (5 min), token_type, expires_in, scope, patient, id_token?, need_patient_banner}`; no
refresh tokens · `GET /fhir/r4/{Patient|Observation|Condition|AllergyIntolerance|MedicationStatement|Immunization}?patient=`
(Observation also `category`, `code`, `date`, `_count`) → `searchset` Bundle · `GET /fhir/r4/{type}/{id}` · `GET
/fhir/r4/Patient/{id}/$summary` → IPS `document` Bundle. Consent screen calls (`/api/v1`): `GET /smart/authorize/request?…` →
`{app, scopes, resources, categories, patients[{person_id, display_name, self, sensitive_allowed}]}` · `POST /smart/authorize
{…request, patient_id, approve, include_sensitive}` → `{redirect_to}` · `GET /persons/{id}/smart-authorizations` · `DELETE
/smart-authorizations/{id}` · admin: `GET/POST /admin/smart-apps`, `PATCH /admin/smart-apps/{id}`. App's IPS for the app user:
`GET /persons/{id}/export/ips`. Errors on `/fhir/r4` are OperationOutcome; OAuth errors are RFC 6749 JSON. Every read is
audited as `export` (`purpose=third_party_app` for apps).

**Wearables (R3 evaluation).** `GET /wearables/providers` (`fake` dev-only; `huawei_health`, `dexcom` = evaluation stubs) ·
`GET/POST /persons/{id}/wearables {provider}` · `POST /wearable-connections/{id}/sync` → `{created, duplicate, rejected}` ·
`DELETE /wearable-connections/{id}`. **Worker:** `wearable_sync` hourly.

**Hub contract (additive, R3 follow-up).** `GET /hub/members` adds `growth{birth_date, sex, age_days, corrected_age_days,
preterm, measures, reference, modules} | null` for children under 10 with a hub-visible growth module; `GET
/hub/members/{pid}/series/{kind}` also accepts `length`, `height`, `head_circumference`. hub-core passes `growth` through
(profile, family-view cards), serves those series, keeps `settings.simple_mode` / prefs `simple_mode`, and its check-in answer
adds `sent` and `delivery: sent|queued|rejected`.

**Other follow-ups.** `GET /persons/{id}/immunizations/due` adds `applies`/`applies_until`: the childhood schedule stops at its
`applies_until` (18) — adults get no childhood items. Growth: no z-score before term-equivalent age (corrected age < 0).

**Settings added** (`app/config.py`): `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, `BILLING_GATEWAY`, `BILLING_FAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `BILLING_GRACE_DAYS`,
`PAYHERE_MERCHANT_ID/SECRET`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY/WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `HMS_CONNECTOR`, `HMS_CONNECT_BASE_URL/API_KEY`,
`SMART_CONSENT_UI_URL`, `SMART_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_S`, `SMART_AUTHORIZATION_DAYS`, `WEARABLE_PROVIDERS`.

## 12. As built — P6 hardening (hardening-p6, 23 Oct 2026)

New router `app/api/privacy.py` (context `app/privacy/`), the scrape endpoint `app/api/metrics.py`, and one middleware
(`app/platform/http_obs.py`). All `/api/v1` routes declare `x-access`; no existing route changed shape.

| Endpoint | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /admin/retention/report` | staff: super_admin, dpo_auditor | Dry-run report: per target (DATA_MODEL.md §8/§17) the rows a purge would remove now, the rows legal holds keep, report-only targets (audit archive, health-record candidates), Traccar (external), the last real run |
| `POST /admin/retention/run` `{dry_run}` | staff (a real run needs MFA) | Runs the purge (or only counts); writes `retention_run` and one audit event with the counts |
| `GET /admin/retention/runs` | staff | Recent runs |
| `GET /admin/legal-holds?active=` · `POST /admin/legal-holds` · `POST /admin/legal-holds/{id}/release` | staff | `{scope: person \| family, person_id \| family_id, reference, reason (encrypted), review_on}`; the reason is returned to `dpo_auditor` only |
| `GET /admin/dsar-sla` | staff | Open, overdue, due within 7 days, extended, open by type, median/max days to close (90 days) |
| `GET /admin/dsar/{id}` | staff | The request with `sla` (due, days_left, overdue, due_soon), export metadata (never a link), outcome, `legal_hold` |
| `POST /admin/dsar/{id}/export` | staff | Builds the zip **as the requester** under the policy (FHIR bundle of the whole history, 12-month PDF, access-log extract, manifest with SHA-256s), stores it privately, notifies the requester (`dsar.export_ready`). Staff never get the file |
| `POST /admin/dsar/{id}/rectify` `{changes, reason}` | staff | Identity fields only (`given_name`, `family_name`, `preferred_name`, `date_of_birth`, `dob_precision`, `sex_for_clinical_use`, `language`); health records use their amend flows |
| `POST /admin/dsar/{id}/erase` `{dry_run=true, confirm_person_id}` | staff (real run: MFA and the person id typed back) | Dry run = exact counts per table, nothing changes. 409 `legal-hold` / `erasure-owner` / `erasure-account`. Completes the request |
| `GET /persons/{id}/dsar` | policy: self or guardian; own requests | The requester's view (no handling notes) |
| `POST /persons/{id}/dsar/{dsar_id}/export-link` | policy: only the requesting account | One-time link `{url, expires_at, bytes, sha256}`, 10 minutes |
| `GET /dsar-exports/{token}` | public: the one-time token; rate-limited, audited | `application/zip`, `Cache-Control: no-store`; second use 404, expired 410. Completes access/export requests |
| `GET /admin/peripheral-models?country=LK` | staff: super_admin, ops_support, clinical_safety_officer, content_manager | The peripheral catalogue (`catalogue/peripherals.yaml`) with that country's regulatory status (NMRA for LK) |
| `GET /metrics` (no `/api/v1` prefix; not in OpenAPI) | Bearer `METRICS_TOKEN`; without a token only in dev/test | Prometheus text: `cure_http_requests_total{method,route,status}`, `cure_http_request_duration_seconds{method,route}`, `cure_http_requests_in_flight`, `cure_build_info`, `cure_process_start_time_seconds`. Labels are route templates — never ids |

Worker: `WORKER_METRICS_PORT` (9108) serves `/metrics` (same token rule): job runs, durations and last success per job,
and DB gauges refreshed at scrape (outbox pending / oldest age / failing / by topic, notifications pending, deliveries in
the last hour, open alerts, synthetic test and audit-chain last result, hub fleet by status / stale heartbeats / firmware /
max sync lag / max queue / low batteries, DSAR open / overdue / due soon, retention last run, active legal holds). New
jobs: `retention_purge` (21:00 UTC) and `dsar_exports` (hourly; deletes expired export files).

Cross-cutting: every response carries `X-Request-ID` (an incoming opaque one is reused) and, unless the route sets its
own, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`,
`Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-site`. Logs are JSON lines through the PHI scrubber (`LOG_FORMAT=json|text`,
`LOG_LEVEL`); uvicorn's access log is off (the API's own access line has the route template, never the query string).
`APP_ENV` now defaults to **production** — local runs set `APP_ENV=dev` (`.env.example` does). New settings:
`LOG_FORMAT`, `LOG_LEVEL`, `METRICS_TOKEN`, `WORKER_METRICS_PORT`, `DSAR_EXPORT_TTL_S`, `RETENTION_ENABLED`, `S3_SSE`.
Notification templates added: `dsar.export_ready`, `dsar.completed`.
